caseName: May v. Illinois ex rel. Gobin
caseNameFull: Thomas May, Jr., in Error v. The People of the State of Illinois for the use of Edward Gobin, etc.
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Fred B. Merrills for the plaintiffs in error. Mr. Charles H. Burton and Mr. James M. Graham for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Rogers v. Clark Iron Co., 217 U. S. 589; Preston v. Chicago, 226 U. S. 447, 450.
